title: Benki Birugali
desc: Daya, an international criminal, has three lovers, namely Mona, Sandhya and Rekha. A police officer, Chandu, approaches the three women and befriends them in order to trap Daya.

title: Venky Mama
desc: Venkatarathnam raises Karthik, his orphaned nephew, on his own after the death of his parents. Things change when Karthik suddenly leaves home without notice.

title: Jeevanadhi
desc: After several years of marriage, a couple becomes parents. However, after a childless couple finds their infant boy, they take him away and try to raise him as their own son.

title: Dheeraj
desc: A gang of dacoits terrorises innocent people by stealing their belongings and killing them afterwards. In response, DSP Dheeraj is ordered to bring them to justice.

title: Bellary Naga
desc: Naga's life takes a turn when his relative, Vishwanath Gowda, puts him in charge of his entire estate for 25 years. However, this does not sit well with Vishwanath's children.

title: Gandhada Gudi
desc: When forest officer Kumar protects natural resources from poachers, their boss, Anand, becomes his main rival. But little does Kumar know that Anand is his brother.

title: Ananthu V/S Nusrath
desc: Ananthu, a lawyer from a traditional Brahmin family, falls for Nusrath, a judge from a different faith, leading to a heartfelt journey of love, family expectations and courtroom drama.

title: Dheeraj
desc: A gang of dacoits terrorises innocent people by stealing their belongings and killing them afterwards. In response, DSP Dheeraj is ordered to bring them to justice.

title: Obbalu Laila Goskara
desc: After returning from a world tour, a man comes across a woman and falls in love with her. However, she has no interest in him and rejects his proposal.
